g.text: Selected flows from the 6,000-second runs · each bar uses that model’s delivered population
Panel scales differ. n = unique deliveries; dropped and unfinished applications are excluded from latency.
Seed 131 has different reachable-source populations. Lower delivered means alone do not establish better service.
